verdict.rationale: GST runs a public help portal and a developer API portal, so agent-oriented documentation such as llms.txt is a fair thing to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack shows an llms.txt file, markdown or agent-targeted docs, or any documentation built for agent consumption. The cited items are ordinary human-facing help modules, user manuals and portal landing pages. The probe only observes that a different tax portal (income tax e-filing) serves a JavaScript shell, which says nothing about GST offering agent-oriented docs.
